item.title: Deadly Choice Health Month
item.description: 4K1G will be promoting healthy choices for life, food and exercise, along with ‘hoops for health’ basketball days with the team from 4K1G – including outside broadcast – and a fishing competition with our team from the fishing show.

item.title: 4K1G Radio School starting August 2022
item.description: The 4K1G radio school is free training for First Nations People that will teach students the basics on how to put together a radio show, Voice, Production, Digital.
